beats.text: Your socket is AC. Your phone is DC.
AC reverses a hundred times a second.
Two thirty volts R M S, peaking at three twenty five.
Transformers need AC to step voltage up.
Ten times the voltage, a hundredth of the loss.
So lines run at four hundred kilovolts, then step down to two thirty.
Your charger's rectifier makes it DC.
Grid is AC, phone is DC, charger translates.
Follow for more, and see how everything works.
